run_requirements.skill_prompt_source: installed skill content frozen for the run
run_requirements.request_transport: raw provider API; no bbg proxy or transform infrastructure

r14.non_sigil_handling: Count as zero-sigil noncompliance, never as malformed sigil input.

paired_benchmark.correctness_requirement: No statistically meaningful regression in task correctness.
paired_benchmark.turn_requirement: No statistically meaningful regression in median turns.
paired_benchmark.cost_requirement: Positive provider-billed cost saving, calculated only from provider usage fields and configured provider pricing.
paired_benchmark.confidence_requirement: Report confidence intervals; label insufficient samples inconclusive.

change_control: Thresholds may change only after a recorded baseline and a documented decision.
